decision: Retain one attributed acquired-graph-context utility hypothesis. Hold launch for root prioritization after the complete active peer family; no new recurrence, serialization or primitive novelty claim.
name: Persistent spanning-forest tour state scan in a competent shared meanSAGE bank
observations_explained: Complete Physics E and sign-dropout banks lost substantially to capable independent ensembles; mean members were markedly weaker and extra correct-member coverage was lost in pooling.
A different graph computation may help individual routes acquire correct evidence before pooling. Input perturbations or downstream diversity identities did not establish that benefit.
Current attribute-peer study is active and its outcomes have not been opened for this proposal.
mechanism: Keep both competent native layers on the full original graph. Between layers, aggregate a learned selective diagonal recurrent state along a complete component-wise spanning-forest Euler tour. Four persistent route-specific tours impose different graph-respecting compression histories while native graph paths remain available.
novelty_boundary: Random walks, shared sequence encoders, recurrence, selective state spaces, Euler serialization, occurrence-to-node averaging, probability averaging and native fast factors all have prior ancestry.

Janossy Pooling directly trains a shared recurrent neighborhood encoder and averages predictions over permutations; Relational Pooling permits shared graph RNN encoders; Graph-Mamba already averages scan orders; GMN uses graph walks and bidirectional Mamba; CRaWl maps shared walk encodings back to nodes.
No exhaustive search or closest-source absence certificate was obtained. The exact persistent private-tour/fast-factor pairing is an experiment to attribute, not a novelty certification.
No full-graph lossless encoding, permutation invariance, expressivity improvement, useful diversity, universal transfer or speed advantage follows from this construction.
predicted_benefit: A path state can carry transformed feature evidence beyond the native two-layer radius and may repair common false-rival errors within individual routes. Different tours may retain different useful evidence, and native probability averaging may preserve some of those repairs.
predicted_harms: 32-channel recurrent compression can erase source evidence or spread unrelated community features; the original graph remaining present does not guarantee preserved predictions.
Repeated tree visits and unavoidable backtracking bias the recurrent context. Mean occurrence readout normalizes each target's multiplicity, not the contextual multiplicity of donors.
Persistent roots/order can overfit; components reset and tree edges omit cyclic shortcuts in the scan. Native layers still use all original edges.
Shared scan maps and common labels may homogenize routes; a tied four-tour learner or an independently trained equipped bank may match or beat SW4.
More oracle coverage may still be lost during probability averaging; zero residual initialization protects the initial forward only.
earlier_experiment_boundary: Distinct from closed fixed private-hop paths, sparse feature-kernel unions, sign dropout, and current attribute-peer feedback. None of those exact completed experiments tests this whole-component traversal scan. Known prior architecture status does not establish futility.
scope: One encountered CoauthorPhysics protocol and one competent source meanSAGE recipe. No global transfer requirement. Positive development needs unused coherent confirmation before a paper claim.
